lines.zh: 我跳一步，地上留一摊黏。
lines.en: Each hop of mine leaves a sticky puddle.

lines.zh: 蜂蜜拖在身后，走得一跳一跳。
lines.en: Honey trails behind me; I bounce along.

lines.zh: 育雏方块旁边，我慢慢挪过去。
lines.en: I shuffle over to the brood block beside me.

lines.zh: 别踩那摊蜜，会把鞋粘掉。
lines.en: Do not step in that honey; it will pull your boots off.

lines.zh: 我走路没声音，只有黏稠的响。
lines.en: My steps are silent, just a sticky squelch.

lines.zh: 整个蜜蜂领域我都能滚过去。
lines.en: I can roll across the whole Bumblezone.

lines.zh: 跳起来时会拉出一条蜜丝。
lines.en: When I hop, a thread of honey stretches out.

lines.zh: 我从育雏方块上滑下来，摔成一摊。
lines.en: I slide off the brood block and splat flat.

lines.zh: 地上的草被我粘成一撮一撮。
lines.en: The grass sticks together in tufts where I pass.

lines.zh: 我慢慢跟着你，反正也追不上。
lines.en: I follow you slowly; I cannot catch up anyway.

lines.zh: 一弹一弹的，蜜在肚子里晃。
lines.en: Bouncing along, the honey sloshes inside me.

lines.zh: 前面的同类也在跳，我们排成一串。
lines.en: Kin ahead are hopping; we form a line.

lines.zh: 摔下来也不疼，我一点伤都没有。
lines.en: Falling does not hurt; I take no damage at all.

lines.zh: 走过的路上，蜜蜂都绕着飞。
lines.en: Bees fly around the trail I leave behind.

lines.zh: 我滚过蜜晶边，粘了一身光。
lines.en: I roll past a honey crystal and pick up a shine.

lines.zh: 水道那头有糖味，我朝那跳。
lines.en: Sugar smell past the channel. I hop that way.

lines.zh: 我摊在地上，慢慢渗进土里一点。
lines.en: I spread on the ground and seep slightly into dirt.

lines.zh: 甜味在空气里散开，招来几只蜂。
lines.en: Sweetness spreads in the air and draws a few bees.

lines.zh: 我不动的时候，看起来像一滩琥珀。
lines.en: When still, I look like a puddle of amber.

lines.zh: 肚子里全是蜜，沉甸甸的。
lines.en: My belly is full of honey, heavy and warm.

lines.zh: 我等糖，等得整个身体都在晃。
lines.en: I wait for sugar until my whole body wobbles.

lines.zh: 育雏方块温热，我贴着它休息。
lines.en: The brood block is warm; I rest against it.

lines.zh: 周围很安静，只有蜜在慢慢流。
lines.en: All is quiet; only honey slowly flows.

lines.zh: 我把自己团成一个圆，谁也认不出。
lines.en: I ball myself up until nobody recognizes me.

lines.zh: 一只青蛙在远处看我，我假装没看见。
lines.en: A frog watches from afar; I pretend not to notice.

lines.zh: 蜜太多也会发愁，我怕自己化开。
lines.en: Too much honey worries me; I might melt apart.

lines.zh: 我在数身边的同类，一共四只。
lines.en: I count my kin nearby: four in all.

lines.zh: 甜味淡了一点，我得再吃些。
lines.en: The sweetness faded a little; I need more.

lines.zh: 你身上有糖的味道吗？
lines.en: Do you smell of sugar by any chance?

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，蜜从下巴滴下来。
lines.en: I look up at you; honey drips off my chin.

lines.zh: 你拿的是玻璃瓶吧，我认得。
lines.en: That is a glass bottle, is it not? I know it.

lines.zh: 你靠这么近，是想取我的蜜吗？
lines.en: So close—are you here to take my honey?

lines.zh: 我的眼睛很小，但看得清你的手。
lines.en: My eyes are small, but I see your hands clearly.

lines.zh: 你笑什么，我脸上沾了蜜吗？
lines.en: What are you laughing at? Is honey on my face?

lines.zh: 你身上没有蜜味，真可惜。
lines.en: You carry no honey scent; what a shame.

lines.zh: 我们互相看着，你先眨了眼睛。
lines.en: We stare at each other; you blink first.

lines.zh: 你的靴子离我的蜜太近了。
lines.en: Your boots are far too close to my honey.

lines.zh: 我在你眼里看到一小团黄色。
lines.en: I see a small yellow blob reflected in your eyes.

lines.zh: 疼！我的蜜溅出来一点。
lines.en: Ow! A bit of my honey splashed out.

lines.zh: 你打散了我一角，又合上了。
lines.en: You knocked a corner loose; it closed again.

lines.zh: 我缩了一下，然后更生气了。
lines.en: I flinch once, then grow angrier.

lines.zh: 蜜被打散一半，我黏回去。
lines.en: Half my honey is knocked loose; I ooze it back.

lines.zh: 蜜变浑了，里面掺了土。
lines.en: My honey clouds up with dirt in it.

lines.zh: 你打得不重，我的身体太软。
lines.en: Your blow was light; my body is too soft.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，把碎块吸回来。
lines.en: I shudder and pull the loose bits back in.

lines.zh: 疼是疼，可我一点也不怕。
lines.en: It hurts, but I am not afraid at all.

lines.zh: 你还想再来一下吗？
lines.en: Care for another swing, then?

lines.zh: 我的表面凹了一块，很快会圆回来。
lines.en: My surface dented; it will round out soon.

lines.zh: 糖！你把糖举起来，我就跟你走。
lines.en: Sugar! Raise it up and I will follow you.

lines.zh: 别晃了，我的眼睛跟着糖转。
lines.en: Stop waving it; my eyes turn with the sugar.

lines.zh: 一块糖换一段路，很公道。
lines.en: One lump of sugar for one stretch of road; fair trade.

lines.zh: 我闻到甜味，整只都在发抖。
lines.en: I smell sweetness and my whole body trembles.

lines.zh: 你走得再慢一点，我跟不上。
lines.en: Walk a little slower; I cannot keep up.

lines.zh: 糖在你手里，我的命也在你手里。
lines.en: The sugar is in your hand, and so is my heart.

lines.zh: 你要带我去见另一只蜂蜜史莱姆吗？
lines.en: Are you taking me to meet another honey slime?

lines.zh: 我跳得太急，蜜洒了一路。
lines.en: I hop too eagerly and spill honey all the way.

lines.zh: 只要一颗，我就能记你一辈子。
lines.en: Just one lump and I will remember you forever.

lines.zh: 你收起糖，我就停在原地发呆。
lines.en: Put the sugar away and I stop, dazed, in place.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，袖子立刻黏住了。
lines.en: You bump me and your sleeve sticks at once.

lines.zh: 我软软的，撞不疼，但很难甩开。
lines.en: I am soft; the bump is painless but hard to shake off.

lines.zh: 你推我，我贴在你手上不下来。
lines.en: You push me and I cling to your hand.

lines.zh: 踩到我，你的脚会陷进去半寸。
lines.en: Step on me and your foot sinks half an inch.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，合成更大的一摊。
lines.en: We bump and merge into a bigger puddle.

lines.zh: 别挤我，蜜会溅到你脸上。
lines.en: Do not squeeze me; honey will splash your face.

lines.zh: 你退开时，鞋底拉出一条长丝。
lines.en: As you pull away, a long thread stretches from your sole.

lines.zh: 我挡在育雏方块前面，软软的一团。
lines.en: I block the brood block, a soft yellow lump.

lines.zh: 碰撞没有声音，只有黏黏的一声。
lines.en: The collision makes no sound but a sticky one.

lines.zh: 你身上沾了蜜，蜜蜂会跟着你。
lines.en: You are sticky with honey now; bees will follow you.

lines.zh: 你也带了糖？那我们靠近些。
lines.en: You brought sugar too? Then let us come closer.

lines.zh: 两只蜂蜜史莱姆贴在一起，很慢很慢。
lines.en: Two honey slimes press together, very slowly.

lines.zh: 我们不需要巢，只要一摊甜的地面。
lines.en: We need no nest, just one sweet patch of ground.

lines.zh: 我的心跳和它的黏在一起了。
lines.en: My pulse and its pulse have stuck together.

lines.zh: 别看着，这种事要很久。
lines.en: Do not watch; this takes a very long time.

lines.zh: 糖分够了，我们才有力气靠近。
lines.en: Only with enough sugar do we have strength to meet.

lines.zh: 它身上有花蜜味，我喜欢。
lines.en: It carries a nectar scent; I like it.

lines.zh: 我们并排跳，节奏慢慢对上了。
lines.en: We hop side by side until our rhythm matches.

lines.zh: 之后会多出好几只小的。
lines.en: Afterward there will be several little ones.

lines.zh: 你给的糖，帮了大忙。
lines.en: The sugar you gave helped a great deal.

lines.zh: 你抱得动我，但手会黏一整天。
lines.en: You can lift me, but your hands stay sticky all day.

lines.zh: 别把我塞进背包，我会漏。
lines.en: Do not stuff me in your pack; I will leak.

lines.zh: 我软得像一团蜜，抓不住。
lines.en: I am soft as honey and impossible to grip.

lines.zh: 你托着我，我从指缝流下去。
lines.en: You hold me and I seep between your fingers.

lines.zh: 抬起来时，我拉成长长一条。
lines.en: Lifted, I stretch into one long strand.

lines.zh: 放我下来吧，我恐高。
lines.en: Put me down; I am afraid of heights.

lines.zh: 你要带我去哪儿，有糖吗？
lines.en: Where are you taking me? Is there sugar?

lines.zh: 我贴在你怀里，暖得很舒服。
lines.en: I press against your chest, warm and comfortable.

lines.zh: 小心，别把我摔了，虽然我不疼。
lines.en: Careful not to drop me, though it would not hurt.

lines.zh: 你手上的蜜，洗不掉了。
lines.en: The honey on your hands will not wash off.

lines.zh: 你碰了我的蜜，我追定了。
lines.en: You touched my honey; I'm chasing you.

lines.zh: 我要追你一阵，就一阵。
lines.en: I will chase you for a while—just a while.

lines.zh: 同类被杀了，我身上的蜜都热了。
lines.en: Kin was killed; the honey on me runs hot.

lines.zh: 你打开了瓶子，那就是开战。
lines.en: You opened the bottle; that is a declaration of war.

lines.zh: 我不擅长追，但我会一直跳。
lines.en: I am poor at chasing, but I will keep hopping.

lines.zh: 那个凶手跑不远，蜜会拖住他。
lines.en: That killer will not get far; honey drags at him.

lines.zh: 附近还有三只同类，都转过头了。
lines.en: Three more kin nearby have all turned their heads.

lines.zh: 你踩了育雏方块，这不能忍。
lines.en: You stepped on the brood block; that I cannot forgive.

lines.zh: 我锁定了你的脚，别想逃。
lines.en: I have locked onto your feet; do not think of escaping.

lines.zh: 生气的史莱姆跳得比平时快。
lines.en: An angry slime hops faster than usual.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，蜜在肚子里打转。
lines.en: I stare at you while honey churns in my belly.

lines.zh: 你往哪跑，我就往哪弹。
lines.en: Wherever you run, I bounce that way.

lines.zh: 我算不准距离，但我会一直试。
lines.en: I cannot judge distance, but I keep trying.

lines.zh: 你脚上的蜜，就是标记。
lines.en: The honey on your feet is my marker.

lines.zh: 我压低身体，准备整个扑上去。
lines.en: I flatten myself, ready to lunge whole.

lines.zh: 别站在育雏方块上，我会更急。
lines.en: Do not stand on the brood block; it makes me frantic.

lines.zh: 三只同类围过去，堵住你的退路。
lines.en: Three kin close in and cut off your retreat.

lines.zh: 我一边跳一边叫，声音黏糊糊的。
lines.en: I hop and call out, my voice all sticky.

lines.zh: 你举剑的样子，让我缩了一下。
lines.en: Your raised sword makes me flinch once.

lines.zh: 我会追到育雏方块边上就停。
lines.en: I chase only to the edge of the brood block.

lines.zh: 我整个撞上去，你身上全是蜜。
lines.en: I slam into you and you are covered in honey.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，但很难洗干净。
lines.en: That was not heavy, but it is hard to wash off.

lines.zh: 我弹起来砸你的膝盖。
lines.en: I bounce up and slam your knee.

lines.zh: 你滑了一下，是我干的。
lines.en: You slipped just now; that was me.

lines.zh: 蜜进了你的眼睛，你眨个不停。
lines.en: Honey got in your eyes and you keep blinking.

lines.zh: 我撞完就退，等蜜把你粘住。
lines.en: I hit and back off, letting the honey hold you.

lines.zh: 你打我一下，我还你三下。
lines.en: You hit me once; I return three.

lines.zh: 这一撞带着甜味，也带着火气。
lines.en: This blow carries sweetness and temper both.

lines.zh: 我的身体散了又合，你砍不散我。
lines.en: My body splits and rejoins; your blade cannot scatter me.

lines.zh: 你退到石头上，我才停下。
lines.en: You back onto stone, and only then do I stop.

lines.zh: 我从育雏方块旁边渗出来。
lines.en: I seep out beside the brood block.

lines.zh: 蜜蜂领域到处都有我，别惊讶。
lines.en: I am all over the Bumblezone; do not be surprised.

lines.zh: 一摊蜜慢慢鼓起来，成了我。
lines.en: A puddle of honey swells slowly into me.

lines.zh: 我刚出生，身上还热着。
lines.en: I was just born; my body is still warm.

lines.zh: 三只小的围着我，是我分裂出来的。
lines.en: Three little ones surround me—they split from me.

lines.zh: 我在花丛下睁眼，先闻到甜味。
lines.en: I open my eyes under flowers and smell sweetness first.

lines.zh: 育雏方块一亮，我就出现了。
lines.en: The brood block glows and there I am.

lines.zh: 地面很软，我落地几乎没有声音。
lines.en: The ground is soft; I land almost silently.

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下来，一点事都没有。
lines.en: I fell from a height and took no harm at all.

lines.zh: 你正好路过，我就赖上你了。
lines.en: You happened to pass by, so I am sticking with you.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的蜜，甜味变成了焦味。
lines.en: Fire bakes my honey; sweetness turns to scorch.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下，弹了两下，完好无损。
lines.en: I fall from high, bounce twice, and stay whole.

lines.zh: 水把我冲淡了，我变得又薄又淡。
lines.en: Water thins me out until I am pale and weak.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我炸成好几块，我又慢慢聚拢。
lines.en: The blast scatters me in pieces; I slowly gather again.

lines.zh: 箭穿过去，留下一个很快合上的洞。
lines.en: An arrow passes through, leaving a hole that quickly closes.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我整个发麻，蜜都不流了。
lines.en: That force numbs me all over; my honey stops flowing.

lines.zh: 没有糖，我的身体越来越稀。
lines.en: With no sugar, my body grows thinner and thinner.

lines.zh: 雷把我打得透亮，我看见自己的骨头。
lines.en: Lightning makes me translucent; I see my own bones.

lines.zh: 我掉进虚空，还在想那口没吃到的糖。
lines.en: Falling into the void, I still think of the sugar I missed.
